candidates.description: This vector represents cultural, historical, and traditional concepts and their modern counterparts.
This feature vector represents concepts related to harm, fear, and threats.
This feature vector represents French auxiliary and copula verbs expressing tense and modality.
This feature vector represents French demonstrative determiners and pronouns.
This feature vector represents common French grammatical words, pronouns, and articles.
French plural articles, possessive pronouns, and common word suffixes ending in "es".
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the character sequence "tern" or substrings related to illumination, guidance, and specific proper nouns.
These tokens represent Roman numerals used in numbers, names, or outlines.
This feature vector represents the concept of units of time and temporal periods.
This vector activates for closing punctuation marks and quotation symbols, often combined with closing parentheses or commas.
